{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where they undershoot true lows",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive correlates with near-term price stabilization and slow recovery",
    "When price is in a clear downtrend, model mean-reversion forecasts are too optimistic and miss the true downward trajectory",
    "Sentiment exhaustion (repeated low/negative values) precedes price consolidation at current levels",
    "Model volatility is too low compared to true outcome volatility, especially during price transitions",
    "Strong sentiment alignment (all positive or all negative) amplifies deviation from model forecasts",
    "As price approaches model forecast levels, true outcomes diverge due to rapid market adjustment"
] }
